definitions.full: H2996. Yabneh יַבְנֶה proper name, of a location ( he causeth to build ) a Philistine city 2Chr 26:6 ᵐ5 L Ἰαβνη (B Ἀβεννηρ ) compare Ἰεμναθ ᵐ5 L Josh 15:46 (A Ἰεμναι ); = יַבְנְאֵל 1 q. v.

occurrences.englishText: He went out and fought against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod; and he built cities in the country of Ashdod, and among the Philistines.
